paragraphs.text: Cards from Amonkhet compared to cards from earlier sets .
The " Bicycle land " cycle is strictly better than the cycling-land cycle from Urza's Saga (e.g., Scattered Groves compared to Drifting Meadow and Slippery Karst ).
Ahn-Crop Crasher is strictly better than Vulshok Berserker .
Aven Initiate is strictly better than Cloud Manta , Moon Heron , Snapping Drake , and Talas Air Ship .
Battlefield Scavenger and Harsh Mentor are strictly better than Falkenrath Reaver .
Blazing Volley is strictly better than Desert Sandstorm and Tremor .
Bloodrage Brawler is strictly better than Minotaur Explorer .
Cascading Cataracts is strictly better than Crystal Quarry .

Colossapede is strictly better than Blanchwood Treefolk , Durkwood Boars , Feral Krushok , Hollowhenge Beast , Ironroot Treefolk , Jasmine Boreal , Meng Huo's Horde , Nema Siltlurker , Plated Wurm , Silverback Ape , The Lady of the Mountain , Thornhide Wolves and Torsten Von Ursus .
Curator of Mysteries is strictly better than Air Elemental and Thought Devourer .
Dune Beetle is strictly better than Bane Alley Blackguard .
Festering Mummy is strictly better than Festering Goblin and Shambling Goblin .
Forsake the Worldly is strictly better than Fate Forgotten .
Gift of Paradise is strictly better than Sheltered Aerie .
Hieroglyphic Illumination is strictly better than Touch of Brilliance and Weave Fate .

Honored Hydra is strictly better than Alpha Tyrranax , Barbtooth Wurm , Canopy Gorger , Cowl Prowler , Craw Wurm , Giant Warthog , Kessig Dire Swine , Kindercatch , Moss Kami , Rootbreaker Wurm , Sulam Djinn , Tusked Colossodon , Vastwood Gorger , Vulpine Goliath and Yavimaya Wurm .
Manglehorn is strictly better than Uktabi Orangutan and Viridian Shaman .
Naga Vitalist is strictly better than Harvester Druid .
Pathmaker Initiate is strictly better than Dwarven Nomad , Dwarven Warriors and Goblin Tunneler .
Pitiless Vizier is strictly better than Giant Cockroach and Nether Horror .
Pouncing Cheetah is strictly better than King Cheetah .
Sacred Cat is strictly better than Trained Caracal .
Scarab Feast is strictly better than Fade from Memory .
Shimmerscale Drake is strictly better than Sandbar Serpent .
Slither Blade is strictly better than Fugitive Wizard , Grayscaled Gharial , Merfolk of the Pearl Trident , Triton Shorestalker , Triton Shorethief and Wandering Ones .
Supernatural Stamina is strictly better than Abnormal Endurance .
Those Who Serve is strictly better than Foot Soldiers , Great Hart , and Pillarfield Ox .
Unwavering Initiate is strictly better than Changeling Sentinel .
Violent Impact is strictly better than Demolish and Volcanic Submersion
Wander in Death is strictly better than Dutiful Return , March of the Returned and Morbid Plunder .
Decision Paralysis is strictly worse than Adverse Conditions , Chilling Grasp , Frost Breath and Sudden Storm .
Haze of Pollen is strictly worse than Lull .
Anointed Procession is a color-shifted Parallel Lives from Innistrad (green to white).
Consuming Fervor is a color-shifted Unstable Mutation from Arabian Nights (blue to red).
Those Who Serve is a color-shifted Colossodon Yearling from Dragons of Tarkir (green to white).
